title: Perfect-completeness two-to-one hardness
exact_target: For every fixed rational $\delta \in (0,1)$, is it NP-hard to distinguish value 1 from value $\leq \delta $ in an explicitly unweighted two-to-one projection game with fixed alphabets [2q] and [q], where every right answer has exactly two preimages?
